title: tap-iostat: Start separating iostat_draw into some static functions
description:
iostat_draw is a very large function. Start introducing some
structure into it by separating the function that calculates
the width and format functions for each column into a static
function.

This is with an eye towards allowing different output formats
later (#10759)
